title: Brake Visit Bookings and Appointment Moves
content:
Brake visits under Brake Service Warranties are booked at any Crestline store.

**Booking window.** The slot must start at least the line's minimum lead time, in hours, after the booking, and no more than the line's booking horizon, in calendar days, after the booking date. The slot holds the line's bay time, in minutes.

**Moves.** One appointment may be moved the line's allowed number of times; each move is booked as a new appointment entry.

**Coverage.** A booking does not decide coverage. Every warranty visit begins with an inspection.

### Both sides of each boundary (illustrative limits, not any line's figures)

Take an illustrative minimum lead time of 3 hours and an illustrative horizon of 10 days, with the booking made at 9:00 on the 1st of a month.

| Proposed slot start | Lead time from the booking | Days after the booking date | Within the rule? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1st, 11:30 | 2.5 hours | 0 | No — less than the minimum lead time |
| 1st, 12:00 | exactly 3 hours | 0 | Yes — "at least" includes the minimum itself |
| 11th, 9:00 | more than 3 hours | exactly 10 | Yes — "no more than" includes the horizon day itself |
| 12th, 9:00 | more than 3 hours | 11 | No — beyond the horizon |

### Points of judgement

- *Which store?* Any Crestline store; the booking is not tied to the store that did the original job.
- *What does a move look like on the record?* A new appointment entry for the new date and time.
- *Does a booking mean the visit is covered?* No. Coverage is decided on the visit, which begins with an inspection.
